Here's a script to add features to voat chat. I originally wrote it to block a certain fake sanegoat who was spamming the chat, making it unusable. Then, I added labeling as a way to easily tell apart parody accounts. Somebody suggested that I store this data in localStorage so it saves your lists. So I did that too.

I know a lot of goats will be skeptical and not want to use my code out of fear of tracking, etc. Please feel free to inspect the code yourself. I know there are parts that should be rewritten. Comments and suggestions are welcome.

Features:

  • Adds ability to block users and categorize them with custom labels and colors.

  • Blocking a user hides all his or her comments in the chat and adds them to a blocked user list at the bottom of the page.

  • Block list and user created label lists are stored in localStorage for future visits.

To test it, copy the following code and paste it into your browser console.

$(function() {
 var s = document.createElement("script");
 s.type = "text/javascript";
 s.src = "https://rawgit.com/EngelberryHumperdingle/voatChatExtras/master/voatChatXtras.js";
 $("head").append(s);
});

Note: To test the persistent lists, you'll have to use a browser plugin to load the script on each visit. For chrome, I use Styler, and for Firefox, Custom Style Script.
